ransom.precondition: The target row's native-final ransom preview is shown, valid and Can Send. Payer, selected option, resource key and exact fixed-point amount are copied unchanged. When an answer is required, the opaque native-final would_accept_now must be known true.
ransom.receipt: A fresh complete player-prisoner collection no longer contains the exact full prisoner CharacterID.

release_unconditional.precondition: The target row's native-final unconditional-release preview is shown, valid and Can Send.
release_unconditional.receipt: A fresh complete player-prisoner collection no longer contains the exact full prisoner CharacterID.

punish_execute.precondition: The target row's execute reason is present only as an opaque native-final boolean and the native-final execute preview is shown, valid and Can Send. The reason value is recorded but never reconstructed or used instead of Can Send.
punish_execute.receipt: A fresh complete player-prisoner collection no longer contains the exact full prisoner CharacterID.

pre_submit_binding: Exact build SHA admission and a separately certified command ABI are mandatory; the semantic-core binder does not certify production dispatch.
Request binds full generation-bearing player and prisoner CharacterIDs, public revision, native revision, proof epoch and date.
Capture the complete PRISONER3 value snapshot twice on application-main in the same paused state.
Require byte-semantic equality of identity, revisions, proof/date, complete rows, native-final previews and readiness before submit.
Submit exactly once. A false submit result is final for that attempt and is never retried.
ack_boundary: A successful submit returns submitted_verification_pending only. Command acceptance or ACK never means the game applied the action.
receipt_binding: The receipt function owns a new PRISONER3 snapshot capture.
Public revision, native revision and proof epoch must all increase; date cannot go backwards; the exact player full ID must remain bound.
The complete collection must be reread. Presence of the exact target full ID is postcondition_failed; absence is applied.
religion_boundary: No faith, doctrine, tenet, conversion or religious option is exposed or interpreted. Any faith-derived legality is consumed only inside the engine's opaque native-final result and finalized Can Send preview.
excluded: torture and custody-change commands, because PRISONER3 does not yet expose a post-action marker sufficient for an honest receipt
native command construction and submission ABI
public bridge, schema or MCP publication
live_boundary: No CK3 instance was started and no command was submitted. This core remains static-ready until a later exact-build native adapter and the single CK3 owner produce a paused live pending ACK plus fresh verified receipt.
